description_expanded:
This stunning, new vacation rental home enjoys a phenomenal location South of 30A overlooking the turtles of South Turtle Bale Pedestrian pathway. Guests will find a private courtyard with a pool that may be heated in the cooler months. Adjacent to the pool is a Summer Kitchen with a built-in grill. The first level offers a spacious great room with an open floor plan and kitchen with a large center island. Also on the first level is a powder room and bedroom with one king-sized bed and private bath. The second level offers a TV den as well as the primary suite with one king-sized bed and two additional bedrooms each with one-king sized bed and private bath. Finally, a laundry room completes the features of the second level. The third level of this home opens to a lower and upper rooftop deck. The upper deck includes ample seating and incredible views over the rooftops of Alys Beach and a partial view of the Gulf. Parking for this home is located in two designated spaces in a parking court. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.

Alys Beach is expanding its development surrounding 29 Fairwind Lane. The photography above may not reflect the current views as impacted by construction. For a construction map, please click the link below.
